headline: Rimini Street Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Rimini Street (NASDAQ:RMNI) reported second-quarter revenue growth and reiterated its full-year outlook, citing demand for its core support offerings, expansion of its enterprise software services portfolio and progress in selling AI-focused solutions. Revenue for the quarter ended June 30 was $111
